subject: general
question:
Select correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the @ signs and balance the following equation.

28 @ 7 @ 12 @ 6 @ 8
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given : 28 @ 7 @ 12 @ 6 @ 8

According to the question, after replacing the signs :

Option 1): ×, =, -, ÷ 

28 @ 7 @ 12 @ 6 @ 8 ⇒ 28 × 7 = 12 - 6 ÷ 8

__**28 × 7**__ = 12 - __**6 ÷ 8**__

196 = __**12 - 0.75**__

196
